description: Local Claude Desktop KCS article drafting adapter for the KCS Authoring Workflow.
long_description: Local KCS Authoring Workflow adapter for Claude Desktop. Use only the listed KCS Authoring tools. If a legacy instruction requires support_get_behavior_instructions, call it at most once, use its returned route, and continue with KCS tools. Do not report Plesk Support Assistant Local as missing. Use kcs_draft_ticket for /draft <ticket_ref>. Use kcs_register_clean_ticket only when sanitized ticket text is visible and no ticket_ref exists. Semantic review is bounded through kcs_prepare_semantic_review and kcs_submit_semantic_review. During semantic review, use only bounded excerpts and return only the exact fields requested by the current packet. Python validates the submission; the operator selects scope; Python owns the final KCS action. Do not choose for the operator, draft manually, or publish. Before drafting, bounded public reuse comparison is presented through kcs_confirm_reuse_comparison; Claude compares only returned accepted ticket facts and cited public excerpts, asks one operator question, and submits only the operator-confirmed closed-enum outcome. No Zendesk writes, Help Center publication, Claude CLI/Code, API key, or external semantic-provider setup is required.
name: kcs-authoring-mvp-validator-control

tools.description: Use immediately for /draft <ticket_ref>. Call with only ticket_ref and optional debug. Do not ask for an attachment.
tools.name: kcs_draft_ticket

tools.description: Use only when sanitized ticket text is visible and no ticket_ref exists. Stores clean_ticket_text and returns next_arguments.
tools.name: kcs_register_clean_ticket

tools.description: Use only for short approved_summary_text or operator selection. For /draft <ticket_ref>, use kcs_draft_ticket.
tools.name: kcs_draft_article

tools.description: Submit only the operator-confirmed outcome after reuse_comparison_required. Copy comparison_ref exactly; reuse or update also requires one displayed candidate_ref. Do not include ticket facts, excerpts, URLs, recommendations, or free-form text.
tools.name: kcs_confirm_reuse_comparison

tools.description: Call only after semantic_review_required. Returns bounded excerpts and submit instructions for item identification.
tools.name: kcs_prepare_semantic_review

tools.description: Submit semantic_issue_proposal_v1 from the prepared packet. No article draft, HTML, item, item_candidates, or raw ticket text.
tools.name: kcs_submit_semantic_review

tools.description: Legacy compatibility helper. If called, use the returned route and continue /draft with KCS Authoring tools.
tools.name: support_get_behavior_instructions
